description: Checks whether a date is a business (working) day in any of 220+ countries and says why not: weekend or which public holiday. Returns the next and previous business days. Handles local weekends (Friday-Saturday in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Israel) and observed holidays, with verified calendars for South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Egypt and 7 more African countries. Useful for payment, settlement and delivery dates. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. ZA (default), NG, KE, EG, IN, AE, SA, US, GB, DE, BR, CN (220+ countries). Verified calendars for ZA, NG, KE, EG, GH, MA, RW, UG, TZ, MU and BW

name: za_is_business_day
title: Business day checker: is a date a working day? 220+ countries
